name: Golden Idol of Good Fortunes

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight.

summary: +1 AC while attuned; Augury once a day, trade goods into coin, and Globe of Invulnerability once a day.
text: While attuned to this idol you have a +1 bonus to AC. Once per dawn you can cast Augury from it; the idol speaks the omen. While holding it, as a Magic action you can turn a nonmagical trade bar or gemstone you touch into coins of equal value, and once per dawn you can cast Globe of Invulnerability from it.

powers.name: Augury

params.text: whispers an omen about the plan you describe: weal, woe, both or nothing

powers.text: Once a day: Augury, spoken by the idol.

powers.name: Coin from Trade Goods
powers.text: Magic action: a gemstone you carry (an onyx, a pearl or a diamond) turns into its full worth in coin.
